<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a significant M+1 peak (~16 % of the base) indicating many carbons, and a strong M+2 peak (~34 % of the base) matching the characteristic 3:1 Cl‑35/Cl‑37 ratio—we can definitively identify carbon and chlorine in the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
